source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of spam filters (PDF 181).

blocks.text: Spam filters unwanted emails ko aap ke inbox se bahar rakhne mein madad karte hain.

Misal: Agar aap ko bohat si promotional (cheezein bechne wali, ad wali) emails aati hain jo aap nahi chahte, to spam filter inhein khud ba khud alag folder mein bhej deta hai ya delete kar deta hai. Is tarah aap sirf woh emails dekhte hain jo aap waqai chahte hain.

blocks.prompt: Agar koi zaroori email ghalti se spam folder mein chali jaye to kya karein?
blocks.explanation: Pehle tasalli karein ke email asli hai, phir use “Not spam” mark karein ta ke woh inbox mein aaye aur filter aage se aisi emails ko sahi pehchane.

items: Spam filter: unwanted emails ko khud alag folder mein bhejta ya delete karta hai.
